<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
before = current_frame
res = action(['RIGHT'], intent='explore')
after = current_frame
def locs(fr):
    out={}
    for n in fr.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color'] in ('b','c','N','g','W'):
            rs=[p[0] for p in n['boundary']]; cs=[p[1] for p in n['boundary']]
            out.setdefault(n['color'],[]).append((min(rs),min(cs),n['pixels']))
    return out
lb, la = locs(before), locs(after)
print('b before', lb.get('b')); print('b after ', la.get('b'))
print('c before', lb.get('c')); print('c after ', la.get('c'))
# any g/W block moved?
print('g count before/after', len(lb.get('g',[])), len(la.get('g',[])))
print('W count before/after', len(lb.get('W',[])), len(la.get('W',[])))
print('result', {k:last_action_result.get(k) for k in ('board_changed','gameplay_changed','no_impact')})
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
